scope: Immutable owner mapping from one approved PART quote line to one persisted stock USE operation and part batch.

record.edge: ticket-stock TLS/HMAC only; BE-0 owns allowlist

recover.rule: Original actor plus current FEE_READ scope. A 404 never authorizes a changed-key retry.

ownerQuery.edge: finance-stock TLS/HMAC only; BE-0 owns allowlist
ownerQuery.returns: Exact current-generation EXECUTED facts only: stable owner receipt and PART items with line/amount/quantity/part/warehouse/order/USE-operation/execution-receipt bindings.

authority: Record requires current employee FEE_SUBMIT, CSRF, company scope, current engineer/order fact and a fresh immutable approval completion whose selected line is PART with the exact amount. Query requires current MONEY_READ and company scope.
stockTruth: Only stock_execution_operation action USE plus its positive exact stock_execution_movement.used_delta is accepted. RESERVE, ISSUE, requests, browser receipts and missing/404/timeout dependencies never imply charged execution.
serialization: Record locks stock_finance_generation, then warehouse and execution order in the same order as stock execution. Active freeze, old generation, return/use in flight, quote replacement, cancellation and unresolved dependency fail closed or wait on the common lock.
uniqueness: One tenant/group/generation/approved line and one tenant/USE-operation/part batch each map once. Same UUID and identical body recover; changed body conflicts.
transactions: Execution, operation and audit commit together. Audit failure rolls all three back. Query is pure and does not mint facts.
integrationStatus: Candidate contract only. V8 migration, trust/gateway allowlists and default service integration belong to BE-0; this file does not claim runtime or independent acceptance.
